name: claude-lean
install_doc: README: `npx claude-lean init` (https://github.com/JacobTheJacobs/claude-lean#readme). It copies itself to ~/.claude-lean and edits $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json; inside the sandbox both are the sandbox HOME/config, so the official installer runs as-is.
notes: Settings only, no MCP server and no instructions for the model: turns off background requests (prompt suggestions, titles, recaps, progress summaries, idle compaction/check-ins), denies ListAgents, caps skill descriptions at 200 chars, makes fast mode per-session, and adds a PreToolUse hook that only warns the user before CLAUDE.md/settings edits.
